findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#s1-tumbleweed" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.45s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Text is hidden beneath an opaque element.
findings.fixHint: Give the text its own zone, raise its stacking order above the covering element, or mark intentional layering with data-layout-allow-occlusion.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply. Decoration nobody needs to read can take data-layout-ignore.
